load_annotations_dict: load annotations from a YAML file and return a dictionary mapping skill names to their labels and alt names
run_load_annotations: run the module to load and print annotations from a YAML file like assets/language_variations/v0.yml
review_load_annotations_dict: review the load_annotations_dict function that parses YAML entries into a labels dictionary with name and alt_name keys
refactor_load_annotations_dict: refactor load_annotations_dict to handle missing alt_name keys or empty YAML entries gracefully
test_load_annotations_dict: test load_annotations_dict by passing a YAML file path and verifying the returned labels dictionary structure
